auth.title: Your space starts here

auth.emailComingSoon: Email and password sign-in is coming next
auth.privacy: Your account keeps this space private and available when you return.

birthData.title: When were you born?
birthData.description: Your birth date shows your planetary signs. An exact birth time also gives us your rising sign and houses.
birthData.dateHint: Use the date shown on your birth record if you have it.
birthData.timeUnknownLabel: I don’t know my birth time
birthData.unknownTimeExplanation: That’s completely okay. We can still use your planetary signs, but we’ll leave out your rising sign and houses.

errors.requiredTime: Enter your birth time or select ‘I don’t know my birth time.’

birthLocation.title: Where were you born?
birthLocation.description: Together with your birth time, your birthplace helps us work out your rising sign and houses for where you were born.
birthLocation.searchPlaceholder: Start typing a city or town
birthLocation.searchHint: Type at least two letters, then choose a result from the list.
birthLocation.noResults: No matching places found. Try a nearby city or a different spelling.

initialIntent.title: What brings you here?
initialIntent.description: Choose the areas that matter most to you right now. We’ll use them to focus your first questions.
initialIntent.contextLabel: What is happening in your life? (optional)
initialIntent.contextPlaceholder: Share as much or as little as feels useful…
initialIntent.contextHint: A recent situation, uncertainty, or recurring thought is a good place to start.
initialIntent.preparingDescription: We’re bringing together what you’ve shared so your first questions feel relevant to you.

errors.areas: Choose at least one area to continue.
errors.astrology: Choose how you’d like AstroCoach to talk with you about astrology.

astrologyPreferences.onboardingTitle: Make the conversation feel like yours
astrologyPreferences.onboardingDescription: Tell us how you’d like astrology to show up. You can change this later.
astrologyPreferences.familiarityQuestion: How familiar are you with astrology?
astrologyPreferences.styleQuestion: How much astrology would you like AstroCoach to include in your conversations?

background.label: Keep it mostly in the background
background.description: Use my chart to guide the conversation, but usually keep the astrology behind the scenes.

balanced.label: Mention it when useful
balanced.description: Bring up relevant astrological connections when they add something useful.

explained.label: Explain the connections
explained.description: Tell me which parts of my chart are informing the exploration and explain why they may be relevant.

deep.label: Go deep
deep.description: Use astrological language freely and explore relevant placements, houses, aspects, and transits in depth.

initialDiscovery.title: A few places to begin
initialDiscovery.description: Take these one at a time. What you share will shape what we ask next.

initialDiscovery.completedDescription: Thank you. You’ve given us a clear place to begin, and we can take it from here.

orientation.title: Here’s how AstroCoach works
orientation.description: Come here when something in your life feels worth understanding. We’ll help you explore it and keep what becomes useful.

share.title: Start with what’s happening
share.description: Bring a moment, feeling, decision, or something you keep noticing.

explore.title: Understand it together
explore.description: We’ll ask thoughtful questions and help you make sense of your own experience.

keep.title: Keep what fits
keep.description: When something feels true and useful, you can save it to My Map and return to it later.

home.title: What’s going on?
home.description: Start with whatever feels most present right now.

composer.error: We couldn’t open that conversation. Please try again.
suggestions: I need to make a decision

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Return to something you were exploring or begin again from Home.
conversations.emptyDescription: When something is on your mind, start from Home and it will appear here.

map.title: My Map
map.description: A place for the patterns, insights, and practices you choose to keep.
map.emptyTitle: Your map will grow with you
map.emptyDescription: Nothing is added automatically. When something useful becomes clear in a conversation, you’ll decide whether it belongs here.

account.languageDescription: Choose the language AstroCoach uses for the app and future responses.
